== Name

cell-substitutions - substitutions in table paragraphs

== Synopsis

Shared note definition.footnote:shared[Shared title note.]

[cols="1a"]
|===
|.Title footnote:shared[] ((Title term))
[#title-target]
Prose (C) link:https://example.org/prose[Prose link].

|.Literal macros
[literal,subs="specialcharacters,macros"]
<code> link:https://example.org/code[Code link] anchor:code-target[]((Code term)) footnote:shared[].

|.Source macros
[source,rust,subs="specialcharacters,macros"]
let value = link:https://example.org/source[Source link]; anchor:source-target[]((Source term))

|[subs="specialcharacters"]
Disabled (C) link:https://example.org/disabled[Disabled link] footnote:[Disabled note.] ((Disabled term)).

|Normal after disabled (C) link:https://example.org/after[After link].

|[subs="normal,-replacements"]
Literal (C) *enabled bold*.

|.Nested table
!===
a!.Nested example
[example#nested-example]
Nested text with <<title-target>>.
!===
|===

Outside <<title-target>>, <<code-target>>, <<source-target>>, and <<nested-example>>.
